turns.text: Good afternoon to you. I trust you are doing well today. I am reaching out because I find myself in need of some technical assistance. Specifically, I would like to create a comprehensive monthly budget spreadsheet to help me track my somewhat complicated finances more effectively.
Good afternoon! I'd be happy to help you set up a monthly budget spreadsheet. Do you have a preferred software like Excel, or would you like to start with a general template?

A general, easy-to-read template would suffice beautifully, thank you. Before we begin, I should mention a critical detail about my financial situation. My income is somewhat irregular these days. Rather than a fixed pension, I earn gig income doing occasional bookkeeping for various small local shops around town.
I see. For irregular gig income, it's often best to budget based on your lowest expected monthly earnings. Should we set up the template with a conservative baseline?

Yes, I agree that taking a conservative baseline is a very sensible approach. Just to give you a bit more context about my life, I am currently 76 years old and a retired hotel night auditor, so this gig work is strictly supplemental income to keep me busy. I live in Port of Spain, by the way, if that matters for currency or local expenses.
Understood. I'll tailor the categories for someone retired and supplementing their income in Port of Spain. What are your main monthly expense categories?

My outgoings are fairly standard, primarily consisting of groceries, utilities, and general household expenses. I should note that I live with my sister Cynthia, so we split the rent and utility bills evenly every month. Furthermore, I currently keep my accounting records in physical ledgers, as I am quite old-fashioned, so I definitely want to be able to print this spreadsheet out cleanly.
That makes perfect sense. I'll format the spreadsheet so it's clean and easy to print alongside your ledgers. Here is a basic template to start with.

This layout looks quite suitable and straightforward, which I appreciate. However, looking it over, could you perhaps add a specific line item dedicated to medical and dietary expenses? I am strictly on a low-sodium diet under doctor's orders, and I frequently need to purchase specialty food items which can be rather costly.
Certainly, I've added a row for medical expenses to accommodate your low-sodium diet. How does the updated version look?

Thank you, that addition is exactly what I needed. One final request before we finish up here—could you please increase the font size across the entire document slightly? My eyesight is simply not quite what it used to be, and larger text will make it much easier to read when I print it.
Absolutely, I've increased the font size for much better readability. Here is the final printable version.

Good morning. I am reaching out because I am seeking some practical advice on improving my general sleep hygiene. Well, actually, I suppose I should specify that what I really need is help establishing a proper, consistent sleep routine that I can stick to every single night.
Good morning. I can certainly help you build a better sleep routine. What does your current sleep schedule look like?

To be perfectly honest, my current schedule is quite poor and erratic. I consistently struggle with my sleep routine due to my past career working as a night auditor at a busy hotel for decades. Because my body is so used to those night shifts, I often find myself wide awake staring at the ceiling at three o'clock in the morning.
That's a very common challenge for former night shift workers. Adjusting your circadian rhythm takes time. Are you currently doing anything specific to wind down before bed?

I am not doing anything particularly structured to wind down, no. I do typically read historical fiction before bed to relax my mind, but that is about it. I should also note for full context that my doctor recently prescribed Lisinopril for my blood pressure, which I take faithfully in the evenings after dinner.
Some medications can affect sleep, though it's best to consult your doctor about that. Aside from reading, would you be open to trying some light stretching before bed?

I suppose I could incorporate some light stretching into my evenings. Oh, there is another rather important detail I forgot to mention—I wear hearing aids during the day, and taking them out at night makes me feel completely isolated and somewhat anxious in the total silence, which definitely keeps me awake and alert.
I understand how that sudden quiet could cause anxiety. Have you considered using a bedside vibrating alarm clock so you feel more physically connected to your environment?

Good day to you. I am currently in the process of writing a formal introductory email for a new volunteer position I have accepted, and I would very much appreciate it if you could review my draft and offer some constructive feedback, please.
Good day! I'd be happy to review your email. Please go ahead and share the draft whenever you're ready.

Thank you kindly. My initial thought was simply: 'To whom it may concern, I am ready to begin.' — Wait, no, pardon me, that is entirely too brief and unprofessional. I volunteer reading to the blind at the National Library, and I truly need to introduce myself properly to the coordinator who manages the program.
That's a wonderful volunteer role. Let's expand it: 'Dear Coordinator, I am writing to introduce myself and express my enthusiasm for beginning my duties reading to the blind...'

Yes, that phrasing is much better and far more welcoming. By the way, the IT department gave me two separate logins. My general volunteer portal username is Eustace78, and my archive volunteer portal username is Eustace_Admin. Could you include those? I must admit I am easily distracted lately, as I am preparing to sell my family's old house in Arima, which is a massive undertaking.
I can imagine the house sale is keeping you very busy. I'll add a brief line with both of your portal usernames so the coordinator has them on file. How does this look?

That looks wonderful with the usernames included. Just one minor adjustment, if you don't mind. Could we perhaps change the formal sign-off to something slightly warmer, like 'Best regards', instead of using 'Sincerely'? I want to ensure I come across as friendly and approachable to the staff.
Done. Here is the final version with the updated sign-off.

Yes, that is perfectly worded and exactly the tone I was hoping to strike. I appreciate your diligent help with this small task. I will go ahead and send the email off to the coordinator right now. Thank you again.
Excellent! Best of luck with your volunteering at the National Library.

Good evening to you. I find myself in need of a thorough distraction this week to take my mind off things. Keeping in mind my reading habits, could you please recommend some engaging, well-written historical fiction novels that I might be able to lose myself in?
Good evening. I'd be glad to recommend some historical fiction. Are there any particular time periods or regions you're most interested in?

I think I would enjoy something set in the 18th century Caribbean, as that era has always fascinated me. To be frank, it has been an incredibly difficult and draining week for my family. My mother passed away at the impressive age of 99 this past Tuesday, and we are still reeling.
I am so very sorry for your loss. That is an incredibly difficult thing to go through. I can certainly provide some captivating historical fiction to offer a gentle distraction.

Thank you sincerely for your kind words; they mean a great deal. To add to the immense stress of the funeral arrangements, the sale of the house in Arima fell through yesterday without warning, as the prospective buyers simply backed out at the very last minute.
That sounds incredibly stressful to deal with right after losing her. Estate matters are never easy. Here are three highly regarded Caribbean historical novels that might provide a welcome escape...

Those certainly sound like wonderful, sweeping epics, but do you happen to have any shorter recommendations in the same vein? Given everything that has happened recently, I find it rather hard to focus on long, dense texts at the moment, so a shorter book might be more manageable.
Certainly, I understand. Here is a shorter novella set in the same era that moves at a quicker pace and might be easier to sink into.
That novella sounds absolutely perfect for my current state of mind. I will see if the local library has a digital copy I can borrow. I greatly appreciate your help and your sympathy this evening.
You're very welcome. Take care of yourself, and have a peaceful evening.

Good afternoon. I hope you are having a pleasant day. I am currently attempting to translate a short, sentimental phrase for a farewell card I am writing, and I require some linguistic assistance to ensure I get the grammar exactly right.
Good afternoon! I can definitely help you with that translation. What is the phrase you would like to translate, and into what language?

I need it translated into Spanish, please. The phrase I want to write is: 'Wishing you the best on your new adventure.' My dear friend Winston moved from San Fernando to Bridgetown, Barbados quite suddenly, and I am putting together a nice farewell card to mail to his new address.
That's a very thoughtful message. A natural way to say that in Spanish is: 'Te deseo lo mejor en tu nueva aventura.'

Ah, excellent, that sounds very natural. I actually take Spanish classes on Tuesday evenings at the community center, but my vocabulary is still quite limited when it comes to expressing complex sentiments properly without sounding like a textbook.
That's completely normal when learning a new language! Consistency with your Tuesday classes will help immensely over time. Would you like a guide on how to pronounce it?

No, that won't be necessary since I am just writing it down in the card rather than speaking it aloud. However, I do have a logistical question. How exactly should I format the international mailing address for Barbados on the envelope to ensure it arrives safely?
For Barbados, just use standard international formatting: Name, Street Address, Parish, Barbados, and the postal code if you have it.
Understood perfectly. I will make sure to follow that exact format when I write out the envelope later today. Thank you so much for the quick and helpful assistance with this translation.
You're very welcome. I'm sure Winston will appreciate the card!

Good morning. I am incredibly excited because I am planning a trip to the UK for three weeks in October to visit distant relatives. I haven't traveled internationally in quite some time, so I really need a comprehensive checklist to help me with packing.
Good morning! I can certainly help with a packing checklist for the UK. Do you know which specific regions you'll be visiting?

I will be spending mostly time in London, though we will likely take a few day trips to surrounding areas in the countryside. The paperwork has been tedious—I applied for a UK visa last month, and thankfully, I received a 6-month UK visa in the mail just this morning.
Congratulations on getting your visa sorted out! Late October in London will be chilly and damp. I'll prepare a checklist focusing on layers and a good waterproof coat.

Oh, please pardon me, I just opened the passport to look at the official stamp a bit more closely. It turns out I received a 2-year UK visa, not a 6-month one as I initially thought! That is certainly a very pleasant surprise that will allow for future visits.
That is wonderful news! A 2-year visa gives you great flexibility for future visits. Here is your tailored packing list for an October trip...

This is an exceptionally thorough and useful list, thank you. To help raise some extra travel funds for spending money in London, I am currently evaluating my physical assets. For instance, I own a 1998 Toyota Corolla, and I also have a 2005 Suzuki motorcycle sitting in the garage.
Selling unused vehicles can definitely provide a nice boost to your travel fund. Are you looking for advice on how to list them for sale locally?

Yes, I think that would be wise. Could you please draft a brief, compelling classified ad for the newspaper? I primarily want to sell my 1998 Toyota Corolla because it is highly unreliable nowadays and simply costs me too much in frequent mechanical repairs.
Certainly. Here is a draft: 'For Sale: 1998 Toyota Corolla. Classic model, sold as-is. Good project car or for parts...' Let me know if you want to tweak it.

That draft is superb. Before I submit it to the local paper, do you think it is better to explicitly list the specific mileage of the vehicle right there in the advertisement, or wait for them to ask?
Yes, definitely include the mileage so potential buyers know exactly what to expect right away.

Good afternoon to you. I am looking to prepare a dish and would greatly appreciate a reliable recipe. Specifically, I need some ideas for simple, elegant finger foods that I can easily bring along to a casual evening social gathering.
Good afternoon! I'd be happy to suggest some finger foods. What kind of gathering is it, and do you have any dietary restrictions to keep in mind?

To give you some context, I recently joined the neighborhood dominoes team, and it is finally my turn to host our practice session at my house tonight. Whatever recipe you suggest, I absolutely need to ensure it allows me to strictly adhere to my low-sodium diet.
That sounds like a fun group! For low-sodium finger foods that are easy to eat while playing dominoes, how about cucumber bites with a salt-free herb cream cheese, or baked zucchini sticks?

Those baked zucchini sticks sound absolutely delightful and perfectly suited for eating with one hand while playing. Could you tell me exactly how long the zucchini sticks need to bake in the oven to become properly crispy?
They usually take about 20 to 25 minutes at 400 degrees Fahrenheit to get nice and crispy.

That baking time is very manageable and fits perfectly into my preparation schedule. On a related health note, I am pleased to share that I stopped taking Lisinopril on my doctor's orders yesterday, as my blood pressure is finally stabilizing quite nicely on its own.
That's fantastic news about your blood pressure stabilizing and being able to stop the medication! Enjoy hosting the dominoes practice tonight.

I am quite relieved to be off the medication, to be honest. Since I have some free time this afternoon, I will go ahead and prepare the zucchini as a small test run right now to ensure I get the seasoning correct before the guests arrive.
Great idea. Let me know how the test run turns out!

Good evening. I am hoping you can assist me with some culinary inspiration. I find myself in need of a robust, filling dinner recipe that can comfortably feed three hungry adults without requiring hours of labor over the stove.
Good evening! I can certainly help with that. Are you looking for something quick for a weeknight, or a more elaborate weekend meal?

I would prefer something rather quick and straightforward for a weeknight. You see, my adult daughter Beatrice moved back into my house this past weekend, which changes our meal dynamics. Furthermore, my daughter Beatrice is a strict vegetarian, so please keep that limitation in mind when suggesting a recipe.
It must be nice to have Beatrice back home! Since you need a quick vegetarian meal for three, how about a hearty lentil and vegetable stew, or a black bean and sweet potato skillet?

The black bean and sweet potato skillet sounds completely wonderful and very nutritious. I just have one quick question about the preparation: do I need to completely peel the sweet potatoes for the skillet dish, or can I leave the skins on?
You don't have to peel them if you scrub the skins well, but peeling is preferred by some for a smoother texture.

Perfect, I will simply scrub them well to save some time; we will certainly try cooking that tonight. In other, rather exciting news, I finally sold my 1998 Toyota Corolla and my 2005 Suzuki motorcycle, and I took that cash and bought a reliable 2010 Toyota Yaris.
That is a very successful week indeed! Congratulations on the vehicle sales and the new Yaris. That should be much more reliable for you.

Indeed it is a huge relief to have a vehicle that starts every morning without fail. My 2010 Toyota Yaris is silver, which is a practical choice because thankfully it doesn't show the road dust nearly as much as the dark green Corolla did.
Silver is a very practical color for exactly that reason. Enjoy the new car, and I hope you all enjoy the sweet potato skillet for dinner!

Good afternoon to you. I am hoping you have a moment to review the monthly budget template we created together quite a while back. My circumstances have evolved, and I want to adapt the spreadsheet to better reflect how I am doing things now.
Good afternoon! I'd be glad to help you adapt your budget template. What kind of changes are we looking to make?

Well, my sister Cynthia generously gave me a brand new iPad for my birthday last month. Because of this modern convenience, I have finally switched my accounting from my old physical ledgers to a dedicated iPad app called Minty, which is quite a leap for me.
What a great birthday gift! Switching to a digital app like Minty can really streamline things. Do you want to adjust the spreadsheet to match the categories Minty uses?

Yes, I would very much like to align my master spreadsheet with the app so everything matches up perfectly. Before I start renaming columns, are there typically smaller subcategories nestled within those main categories in that particular application?
Yes, Minty relies heavily on subcategories. For example, 'Gas' and 'Maintenance' are usually subcategories under a main 'Auto' category.

Ah, I see. That makes a lot of sense for tracking specific expenses like fuel versus repairs. For now, could you simply list out the standard, main, top-level categories they use so I can build the broad framework of my new spreadsheet?
Certainly. The standard main categories include: Auto & Transport, Bills & Utilities, Food & Dining, Health & Fitness, Home, and Shopping.

That list is exceedingly helpful and gives me exactly the structure I was looking for. I will sit down this evening and diligently update my personal spreadsheet to mirror those exact categories. Thank you for your continued guidance on this.
You're quite welcome! Enjoy using the new iPad and the Minty app. Let me know if you need anything else.

Good morning. I find myself in a bit of a social predicament and I require a very polite, tactful way to formally decline an invitation to a rather large weekend social event that an acquaintance is hosting.
Good morning. I can help you draft a polite decline. Are you declining because of a scheduling conflict, or would you prefer a more general excuse?

It is a scheduling conflict, unfortunately. I was recently promoted to captain of my neighborhood dominoes team, which is a great honor but unexpectedly demands significantly more of my time and energy to organize the weekend tournaments.

Congratulations on the promotion to captain! That's quite an honor, though it surely adds to your schedule. Here is a polite draft: 'Thank you for the invitation, but unfortunately, I have a scheduling conflict...'

That draft is perfectly fine and sets the right tone. In addition to the dominoes, I recently switched my volunteer role to organizing archives at the library, which is exhausting. Also, my Spanish classes were moved from Tuesday to Wednesday evenings as well, so my entire week is disrupted.
You are certainly keeping busy with the archives and the schedule changes! Would you like me to add a brief mention of your busy schedule to the decline?

No, please keep the message simple; I do not wish to burden them with a long list of my various commitments. Given the phrasing we settled on, should I send this decline via a quick text message or a more formal email?
A text message is perfectly fine and standard for a casual weekend social event.
Very well, I agree that a text message is probably the most appropriate and direct method for this specific acquaintance. I will go ahead and text them this morning to get it over with. Thanks again.
Sounds like a plan. Have a great day!

Good afternoon to you. I am hoping you can provide some assistance with writing a brief, professional thank you note to the library IT department, as they were very helpful to me recently and I want to express my gratitude.
Good afternoon! I can certainly help with that. What specifically would you like to thank them for?

After struggling with multiple logins for months, I finally sat down with them and I consolidated my volunteer accounts 'Eustace78' and 'Eustace_Admin' into a single username called 'Eustace_POS'. The young man there patiently assisted me with the entire merging process.
That sounds much more convenient! Here is a brief note: 'Dear IT Team, I am writing to sincerely thank you for your assistance yesterday in consolidating my accounts...'

That draft is excellent. It is polite, concise, and conveys exactly what I wanted to say. Having just 'Eustace_POS' will certainly be much easier for a man of my age to remember every time I need to log in to the system.
It certainly will be. Having just one login should make accessing the portal a breeze. Is there anything else you need help with today?

No, that is the only task I needed assistance with today. Though, I must confess, my doctor had me restart taking Lisinopril yesterday due to a slight spike in pressure, and unfortunately, it has left me feeling rather lethargic and out of sorts all afternoon.
I'm sorry to hear you're feeling lethargic. Adjusting to a medication again can take a toll. Make sure to take it easy today and get plenty of rest!

Good evening. I am writing to you because I am in need of some holistic health advice. Could you please suggest some simple, effective relaxation techniques? Lately, I have been experiencing persistent mild headaches that I am quite certain stem from stress.
Good evening. I'm sorry to hear about the stress headaches. Deep breathing exercises, progressive muscle relaxation, or simply taking a quiet walk can be very effective. Have you tried any of these?

I have tried walking in the mornings, which helps temporarily. In a major effort to reduce my mental burden, I formally resigned as captain of the dominoes team and returned to being a regular player, as the organizational duties were simply too much pressure.
That sounds like a very wise and healthy decision. Stepping back from leadership to just enjoy the game should significantly reduce your stress load.

That is exactly what I am hoping for—a return to simply enjoying the fellowship without the administrative headaches. Regarding the physical techniques, exactly how many times should I repeat the deep breathing exercises you just mentioned to see a benefit?
Four cycles is a good start. Specifically, the '4-7-8' method: inhale for 4 seconds, hold for 7, and exhale for 8.

I understand, four cycles sounds like a very reasonable starting point that won't make me dizzy. As I said, I am truly looking forward to just playing dominoes with my friends without the constant anxiety of organizing the brackets and tournaments anymore.
Absolutely. It will be nice to return to the pure enjoyment of the game. Try the breathing technique when you feel a headache coming on.

I appreciate the encouragement and the clear instructions. I think I will turn off the screens, sit quietly in my favorite armchair, and try the 4-7-8 breathing method right now before bed. Have a good night.
Take your time with it. I hope the headaches subside very soon.
Good afternoon to you. I find myself facing a bit of a digital dilemma today, and I have a somewhat urgent technical question regarding how data is managed within iPad applications.
Good afternoon! I'd be happy to help with your iPad question. What seems to be the issue?

The situation is this: the company sent an email saying their servers are going offline. Consequently, I switched my accounting app from Minty to a new one called PocketLedger because Minty shut down permanently and unexpectedly this week.
Ah, that's frustrating when an app you rely on closes down. Are you having trouble figuring out how to use PocketLedger, or transferring your old data?

I am trying to figure out how to rescue all my financial history before the app becomes completely inaccessible. Is a CSV file the only format I can use to reliably export my data out of the old system?
Yes, CSV (Comma Separated Values) is the universal standard for exporting financial data, and PocketLedger will easily import it.

That makes sense, and I am glad PocketLedger accepts that format. I am feeling a bit anxious because I need to ensure I successfully export all the data before the Minty servers go completely offline this coming Friday at midnight.
Usually, there's an export option in the settings menu. Open Minty, go to Settings or Account Preferences, and look for 'Download CSV'.

Ah, I followed your instructions, dug into the Account Preferences menu, and I am relieved to report that I found the export option and downloaded the CSV file successfully to my device. The crisis is averted.
Excellent! You should now be able to import that CSV file directly into PocketLedger. Let me know if you hit any snags.
Good morning. I am hoping you might be able to act as a personal shopper of sorts today. I am looking for a thoughtful, practical gift recommendation suitable for an elderly woman.
Good morning! I can certainly help with some gift ideas. Could you tell me a little bit about her interests, or the occasion?

It isn't for a birthday or holiday; it is just a 'thinking of you' gift to lift her spirits. My sister Cynthia suffers from severe arthritis, which unfortunately makes her hands ache terribly during the damp weather we've been having.
That's very thoughtful of you. Since she has arthritis, gifts that provide comfort are wonderful. How about an electric heated hand massager or some copper compression gloves?

A heated hand massager sounds like a brilliantly comforting idea that she could use while watching television. Out of curiosity, which specific brand of heated massager is currently considered the most reliable and safe on the market?
Brand X and Brand Y are generally the most highly rated for durability and consistent heat levels.

I will go ahead and order the Brand X model online today. On a personal note, my house is quieter—my daughter Beatrice finally found a flat and moved out this past weekend. Also, wonderful news, my doctor said I no longer need to be on a strict low-sodium diet! I grow tomatoes and peppers in my garden, so I plan to enjoy them fully with a pinch of real salt now.
That is a lot of wonderful news! Congratulations to Beatrice on the new flat, and to you on the improved health and diet flexibility. Your garden harvest sounds delicious.

Yes, it has been a week of profound and mostly positive changes in our household. Thank you so much for the excellent gift ideas today; I know Cynthia is going to absolutely love the hand massager. Have a splendid afternoon.
You're very welcome. Enjoy your tomatoes and peppers!

turns.text: Good day. I am requesting assistance with translating an old official letter from German into English. I am an eighty-four-year-old retired home-care worker here in Windhoek, and I rent an apartment on Kasch Street in Windhoek Central. The municipal notice discusses refuse collection and property maintenance charges, but my German is very rusty.
Good day, Mr. Shilongo. Please share the text or details of the notice, and I will gladly translate and explain the municipal charges for you.

Here is the heading: 'Mitteilung über Abfallgebühren und Eigentümerpflichten'. In my lease, I pay a monthly rent of 3,200 Namibian dollars to my landlord Mr. Van Wyk, and my monthly state pension is deposited into a Standard Bank Namibia savings account. Does this notice mean the tenant must pay the refuse levy directly to the municipality?

Under standard City of Windhoek municipal bylaws, refuse removal levies are billed to the registered property owner rather than the tenant, unless your lease agreement explicitly transfers that liability to you.
Thank you kindly. Could you draft a brief and respectful note to Mr. Van Wyk pointing out that the refuse fee belongs to the owner according to clause 4?

Here is a draft note:

Dear Mr. Van Wyk,

I hope this message finds you well. Regarding the recent municipal notice on refuse charges, clause 4 of our lease agreement specifies that property levies remain the responsibility of the owner. Kindly confirm that this item will be handled on your account.

Warm regards,
Barnabas Shilongo

That is very polite. Please format it so I can send it from my email b.shilongo@iway.na. Also, I am typing slowly today because of my long COVID breathlessness, for which I take my Budesonide inhaler 200 micrograms twice daily.
I have formatted the email with your address in the signature line. Please take your time and rest if you feel fatigued while typing.

One last matter: every month on the 25th, I send my monthly family remittance of 1,500 Namibian dollars via Western Union to Ondangwa, where my younger sister Helvi cares for our family homestead and four orphan grandchildren. Could you write a one-sentence payment reference note to accompany the postal voucher?
Here is a suitable reference note: 'Monthly family support remittance for Helvi Shilongo and grandchildren, Ondangwa homestead, November 2024.'

Good day. I am seeking clarity regarding Namibian tax exemption rules for pensioners. My mother Kuku Martha is 103 years old and lives at our family homestead in Ondangwa, and I keep our family documents in my personal safety deposit box at Standard Bank Gustav Voigts branch in Windhoek. Do I need to declare small family maintenance transfers on an annual tax return?

In Namibia, casual family maintenance support and living allowances sent from your pension income are not subject to donations tax, nor do they need to be declared as taxable income by your dependents.
Thank you, that is a relief to know. Is there any formal declaration form required by the Receiver of Revenue for informal cash support under 50,000 Namibian dollars?
No formal declaration form is required for regular family maintenance amounts well below the annual statutory threshold.

Understood. My brother Festus purchased a second-hand Toyota Hilux bakkie for farm transport, so we were wondering about asset declarations. Also, on Saturday mornings I play lawn bowls at the Windhoek Country Club, and on Tuesday mornings I attend a German language conversation circle at the Goethe-Institut. Are club membership fees deductible in any way?
Recreational and social club fees such as lawn bowls or language circles are considered personal expenses and cannot be deducted on your tax return.
I expected as much, but it was worth asking. Thank you for making the tax terms straightforward.
You are very welcome, Mr. Shilongo. Feel free to ask whenever you need assistance with official documentation.
Lastly, I recently signed a testament appointing my nephew Immanuel as the sole executor of my last will and testament. Does the executor have to pay an estate duty filing fee upfront in Namibia?
No, the executor does not pay estate duty upfront out of their own pocket; administrative fees and any master's office duties are settled directly from estate assets during probate.

Good morning. Could you please look up the municipal bus timetable for Windhoek? My close friend and former coworker Tomas lives in Windhoek, and I want to visit him. I drive a 2004 Nissan Sunny for local errands with a valid driver's license, but petrol prices have risen sharply this month.

The City of Windhoek municipal buses operate regular morning and afternoon routes connecting Windhoek Central, Katutura, and Khomasdal, with departures roughly every 30 to 45 minutes during peak hours.
Does the municipal bus line stop directly outside the Katutura clinic on Independence Avenue?
Yes, several municipal routes along Independence Avenue have designated stops directly in front of and across from the Katutura State Hospital and clinic complex.

Good to know. Today is Valentine's Day, but my newly wedded wife Selma and I celebrate our wedding anniversary on November 18. Could you suggest a modest restaurant in town with easy ground-floor access for an evening dinner?
The Stellenbosch Wine Bar and Bistro in Bougain Villas offers flat courtyard entry without stairs, and the restaurant at Hotel Thule in Eros provides easy ground-level access and quiet seating.
Is it customary to book two or three days in advance for a quiet weekday evening table?
Booking two days in advance is generally recommended, particularly if you wish to secure a quiet table close to the entrance.

Thank you. I must be cautious because I follow a strict low-histamine diet to manage post-COVID hives and inflammation. My wife Selma worked as a head matron at Katutura State Hospital before retiring, so she reminds me constantly to avoid aged meats, cured fish, and fermented foods.
You can request freshly cooked poultry or un-aged fish prepared simply without marinades, wine, or vinegar, which will align safely with your low-histamine guidelines.

Good day. I am requesting assistance with drafting an administrative inquiry letter. I hold a reserved burial plot at Gammams Cemetery in Khomasdal, Windhoek, and I need to ask the municipal parks and cemetery department about their annual maintenance upkeep records.
I can certainly help you draft that inquiry. We can include your plot registration number, request verification of groundskeeping records, and confirm any outstanding annual maintenance dues.
Could you help me phrase a formal inquiry to the cemetery office regarding annual maintenance upkeep fees and electronic payment methods?

Here is a formal draft:

To: Department of Parks and Cemeteries, City of Windhoek
Subject: Inquiry Regarding Grave Plot Maintenance and Dues — Gammams Cemetery

Dear Sir/Madam,

I am writing to request an updated statement of accounts and groundskeeping verification for my reserved burial plot at Gammams Cemetery, Khomasdal. Kindly provide details regarding current annual maintenance fees and the municipal banking details for electronic fund transfers.

Yours faithfully,
Barnabas Shilongo

The draft is very well stated. Speaking of bank transfers, since two weeks ago I send my monthly family remittance to Ondangwa via Bank Windhoek EasyWallet mobile transfer, so my sister can collect the money at the local grocery shop. Also, with the afternoon heat, I am considering purchasing a solar-powered rechargeable fan for our bedroom next summer. Do those fans last through load-shedding?

Quality solar rechargeable fans with lithium batteries typically run for four to eight hours on low speed during power outages. For your EasyWallet records, remember to record each twelve-digit transaction code in your ledger.
Thank you, that is very clear. I will write down the transfer reference numbers diligently in my notebook.
Keeping a written ledger is an excellent habit. Please reach out whenever you need further correspondence drafted.

Good afternoon. My doctor reviewed my lung function tests yesterday and my doctor increased my Budesonide inhaler dosage to 400 micrograms twice daily. Could you suggest a gentle indoor breathing and pacing routine that will not trigger fatigue?

A gentle routine could include five minutes of pursed-lip diaphragmatic breathing in a comfortable chair, followed by short five-minute indoor walks on flat surfaces, resting immediately if your breathing quickens.
Thank you, that pacing routine seems manageable. What should my target resting heart rate be during the cool-down?
For gentle cool-down, your heart rate should gradually settle back toward your baseline resting rate, ideally staying below 85 to 90 beats per minute within ten minutes of resting.

I need to fit these exercises around my schedule: my German language conversation circle at the Goethe-Institut meets on Thursday afternoons now instead of Tuesday mornings. Should I do the breathing exercises before or after such social outings?
Doing your breathing exercises before leaving can help relax your chest and conserve stamina, and a brief session after returning helps your body recover from travel.

Understood. I notice my stamina was quite reasonable when I attended the 35th Namibian Independence Day church service at Christuskirche in March 2025. Last month in May 2025 I completed a five-day course of amoxicillin for a mild tooth infection, but thankfully that infection cleared up completely.
It is wonderful that your dental infection resolved without complications. Continuing with slow, consistent pacing will protect your recovery as you adapt to your adjusted inhaler dose.

Good day. I need your assistance to write a polite letter to our neighbour regarding an overgrown bougainvillea hedge. I moved with my wife Selma into her owned house in Hochland Park, Windhoek, ending my apartment tenancy on Kasch Street. The neighbour's hedge is leaning heavily over the precast boundary wall.

Congratulations on moving into your new home in Hochland Park. Here is a courteous draft you can share with your neighbour:

Dear Neighbour,

We hope you are well. As your new neighbours at the adjoining property, we would appreciate it if we could discuss trimming the bougainvillea hedge along our shared boundary wall to prevent damage to the precast panels. Please let us know when it suits you for a brief chat.

Warm regards,
Barnabas and Selma Shilongo

That letter is polite yet clear. By the way, my legal wedding anniversary with my wife Selma is on November 28; November 18 was only our church blessing date. Could you make sure the letter references municipal garden bylaws so he understands our duty?

Here is the revised letter with a polite mention of municipal guidelines:

Dear Neighbour,

We hope this note finds you well. As your new neighbours, we would like to coordinate regarding the bougainvillea along our boundary wall, in line with City of Windhoek guidelines concerning shared fence maintenance and overhanging growth. Kindly let us know a convenient time to discuss trimming it together.

Warm regards,
Barnabas and Selma Shilongo
That is very firm and polite. If the neighbour does not respond within two weeks, is it permitted under Windhoek regulations to trim branches that cross the boundary line onto our side?

Yes, property owners are generally entitled to trim branches that protrude over their property line up to the boundary wall, provided the clippings are offered back or disposed of without entering the adjacent property.

I will speak with him personally before trimming anything. Unfortunately I cannot do heavy garden work myself because I suffered a severe torn meniscus in my right knee during a lawn bowls match in August 2025. And as always, I still experience shortness of breath when walking up steep inclines.
Please avoid any heavy pruning or stair climbing with a torn meniscus and long COVID breathlessness. It is far safer to have a local gardener or family member assist with the physical trimming.

Good morning. I am looking to purchase a reliable digital pulse oximeter and a home blood pressure monitor. Because of my knee injury, I permanently stopped playing lawn bowls due to my right knee meniscus injury, so I need to monitor my vitals at home with less active movement.

For home health monitoring, the Omron M2 or M3 upper-arm blood pressure monitor is highly regarded for seniors, and for oxygen monitoring, a Beurer PO 30 or Contec CMS50DL fingertip pulse oximeter with Bluetooth data export offers clear, large digital displays.
Do fingertip pulse oximeters give reliable readings if one's fingers are slightly cold in the early morning?
Cold fingers can restrict blood flow and lead to inaccurate readings, so it is best to warm your hands by rubbing them together before clipping the sensor onto your finger.
Thank you for that advice. My doctor reviewed my renal blood panels and I switched from a low-histamine diet to a renal-friendly low-potassium diet. Could you explain what foods I must avoid now?

On a low-potassium diet, you should limit foods high in potassium such as bananas, oranges, potatoes, tomatoes, avocados, and spinach. Opt instead for apples, berries, cabbage, cucumbers, and white rice.

That is helpful. My close friend Tomas moved from Windhoek to Swakopmund to live near his daughter, so I cannot chat with him over tea as often. My neighbour recommended drinking boiled moringa leaf tea for joint pain, but I declined to use it because herbal teas can be harsh on kidneys.
You made a very wise decision to decline the moringa tea, as herbal brews can have unpredictable potassium levels and may place unnecessary strain on kidney function.
Thank you kindly. I will stick to warm boiled water with a little lemon peel.
That is a very safe and refreshing choice. Wishing you steady health and restful days.

Good day. It is a sorrowful time for our family. My mother Kuku Martha passed away peacefully at age 104 in Ondangwa in late November 2025. I would like your assistance to draft a formal note of acknowledgment and thanks for our church congregation in Windhoek.

My sincere condolences on the passing of your beloved mother. Here is a respectful acknowledgment note:

Dear Brothers and Sisters in Christ,

The Shilongo family wishes to express our deepest gratitude for your comforting prayers and condolences following the peaceful passing of our mother, Kuku Martha, at the age of 104 in Ondangwa. May the Lord bless you for your steadfast support during this time of mourning.

In Christian love,
Barnabas Shilongo and Family
Thank you, that wording honors her memory beautifully. Could you add one sentence thanking the deacons specifically for their home visits?

Here is the updated note with that addition:

Dear Brothers and Sisters in Christ,

The Shilongo family wishes to express our deepest gratitude for your comforting prayers, messages, and condolences following the peaceful passing of our mother, Kuku Martha, at age 104 in Ondangwa. We extend our heartfelt thanks especially to the deacons for their visits and spiritual comfort. May the Lord bless you all.

In Christian love,
Barnabas Shilongo and Family

That is complete now, thank you. Regarding family support in Ondangwa, the EasyWallet agent in the village closed down, so I switched my monthly remittance to Ondangwa back to Western Union cash pickup at the main post office. Also, my eyesight at dusk has worsened, so I surrendered my driver's license to NaTIS, gave away my car, and rely exclusively on a municipal bus pass.

Making those adjustments shows admirable foresight and responsibility, both in ensuring your sister receives her remittance reliably and in keeping yourself safe on the road by utilizing public transport.
Thank you. Is there a senior discount application form required for the municipal bus pass renewal each year?
Yes, the City of Windhoek requires seniors to present their national identity card and proof of residence once a year at the Customer Care Centre to renew their concessionary transit card.
I will bring my identity document to the municipal office next week.
That will keep your transit pass active without interruption. Please take care of yourself during this period of grief.

Good afternoon. We are hosting a quiet lunch at our home in Hochland Park for our pastor and his wife. My pulmonologist reduced my Budesonide inhaler dose to 200 micrograms once daily at night. Could you help design a lunch menu keeping to my low-potassium restrictions?

A delicious low-potassium lunch could feature roast chicken breasts seasoned with thyme and rosemary, served alongside steamed green beans, boiled white basmati rice, and a crisp cucumber salad with a light olive oil dressing.
Can white basmati rice and steamed green beans be cooked ahead on Friday and gently reheated without spoiling?
Yes, both white rice and green beans refrigerate well in airtight containers and can be gently reheated with a tablespoon of water to restore moisture.

The menu sounds very suitable. I work as a paid part-time weekend telephone intake coordinator at the Katutura Community Palliative Care Registry, working eight hours across Saturday and Sunday. Preparing simple food always reminds me of my youth; I grew up herding cattle on a communal farm outside Otjiwarongo during the 1940s and 1950s.
Your telephone coordination work at the palliative registry is a wonderful way to continue supporting your community, and your memories of growing up on the land reflect a rich life journey.
Thank you. Working on the phones allows me to use my nursing experience while sitting comfortably without climbing stairs.
It is an ideal match for your skills and physical needs. I hope you and your guests have a wonderful lunch together.

Good day. Telecom Namibia has discontinued their iway webmail service, so my primary email address is barnabas.shilongo84@gmail.com. Could you provide a clear step-by-step on how to update my email address on my government pension portal?

To update your pension portal contact details, log in with your national ID number, navigate to 'My Profile' or 'Contact Information', click 'Edit', enter barnabas.shilongo84@gmail.com, and confirm the change via the verification link sent to your new inbox.
When updating my Gmail security settings, is it safer to use an authenticator app or SMS text messages on an MTC mobile phone?
An authenticator app is technically more secure, but SMS text verification via your MTC mobile number is very reliable and much easier to manage day-to-day.

I will stick to SMS verification. Because of my afternoon fatigue, I withdrew permanently from the German language conversation circle at the Goethe-Institut. Our family is pleased because my stepson Levi enrolled in an automotive mechanics apprenticeship in Arandis.
Withdrawing from the afternoon group is a wise way to preserve your energy, and congratulations to your stepson Levi on securing his mechanics apprenticeship.
Thank you. He has a keen eye for engines and we hope he does well.
Mechanics is an invaluable trade in Namibia, and he will undoubtedly learn practical skills that serve him throughout his life.

Good morning. I am inquiring about formal cemetery administrative transfers. I transferred my reserved burial plot from Gammams Cemetery to my ancestral family cemetery in Okahandja to rest beside my late father. Could you advise how long municipal deed cancellations usually take?
Municipal plot surrender and deed updates in Windhoek typically take between four to six weeks once the sworn affidavit and original deed receipt are lodged with the cemetery registrar.
Is it advisable to request a stamped confirmation receipt when submitting the original cemetery deed papers to the municipal cashier?
Yes, always request a date-stamped copy of your surrender letter and keep the municipal cashier's receipt for your permanent records.

I will do that. Last week, I closed my Standard Bank savings account and safety deposit box and consolidated all banking into a joint First National Bank Namibia account with Selma. Also, after experiencing hives from dried apricots, I was diagnosed with a mild dietary allergy to sulfites found in dried fruits and vinegar. Which condiments are safe?

To avoid sulfites, steer clear of commercial vinegars, wine-based sauces, and treated dried fruits. Safe condiments include freshly squeezed lemon juice, plain olive oil, fresh garlic, and pure herbs without preservatives.
Thank you, that is very helpful advice for our kitchen pantry.
You are very welcome, Mr. Shilongo. Fresh herbs and olive oil will give you plenty of flavor safely.

Good afternoon. I am preparing a formal codicil to update my last will and testament at the magistrate's court. I updated my will to appoint my wife Selma as sole executor, replacing my nephew Immanuel who works long shifts in the Erongo mines. How should this clause be phrased?

Here is a standard executor revocation and appointment clause:

'I hereby revoke the appointment of my nephew, Immanuel Shilongo, as executor of my estate, and appoint my wife, Selma Shilongo, as the sole executrix and administrator of this my Last Will and Testament.'
Must the two independent witnesses be present in the room at the exact same moment when I sign the codicil?
Yes, under Namibian law, both witnesses must be physically present at the same time and watch you sign, after which they each sign in your presence and in the presence of each other.

We will arrange two church elders to sign as witnesses. My wife Selma underwent successful cataract surgery on her left eye at Windhoek Central Hospital in June 2026, so her eyesight is very sharp now and she can review the papers with ease.
That is wonderful news regarding your wife's vision. Having church elders serve as independent witnesses is a very prudent and dependable choice.
Thank you kindly. You have explained the legal requirements with great clarity.
It is my pleasure, Mr. Shilongo. Wishing you peace of mind as you finalize your affairs.

Good day. Tomorrow morning I am taking the municipal bus from Hochland Park to the Katutura Community Centre. I donated four hand-knitted woollen blankets to the Katutura Community Palliative Care Registry where I work on weekends, and I want to deliver them. What is the Saturday morning bus schedule from Hochland Park?
Saturday morning municipal buses from Hochland Park depart at 07:15, 08:30, and 10:00 toward the central terminal, where you can connect to the Katutura feeder bus.
Do the weekend buses run on their regular schedule during the current school holiday period?
Yes, Saturday municipal transit operates on its standard weekend timetable regardless of public school holidays.

That is reassuring. Also, to align with when the palliative care registry pays my monthly stipend, I send my monthly family remittance to Ondangwa on the 1st day of each month instead of the 25th. Could you draft a brief SMS update for my sister Helvi?

Here is a brief, clear SMS draft:

'Dear Helvi, our monthly remittance will now be sent on the 1st of every month via Western Union at the post office. Warm love to you and the children.'
Thank you very much. That message is polite and completely clear. Have a blessed weekend.
You are most welcome, Mr. Shilongo. Have a safe journey on the bus tomorrow and a blessed weekend.

turns.text: Dzień dobry. I am writing to you because I need a good study plan. It is for the Icelandic language, which is very hard. I am a retired parliamentary researcher, so I know how to study, but I need structure. I was born in 1943, so my memory is not what it used to be. Please make it simple for me.
Hello! I can certainly help you with a structured study plan for Icelandic. Since you want to keep it simple, we will break it down into easy, daily segments.

My friend told me 'you should use Duolingo', but I am not sure if that is the best way. I want to study for exactly 30 minutes each day. I live in Reykjavik now, and I really need this language for going to the shops and asking for directions when I am lost. Can we do this?
Thirty minutes a day using an app is a great start for practical vocabulary. We can focus on exactly what you need for shops and asking directions around Reykjavik.

Numbers would be very good to start with. I share a flat with two friends, Jón and Ewa, and we always need to split the bills for electricity and water. It is complicated when I do not know the numbers. Also, I use a Samsung smartphone. Is there an app you recommend I download for this?
Learning numbers to split bills with Jón and Ewa is a perfect first step. For your Samsung smartphone, I highly recommend downloading either Drops or Memrise.

Make it focus on pronunciation too. I want to sound correct when I speak to people in the shops. Sometimes they do not understand me, and I just point at things. So we must practice how to say the words out loud. That is the most important part for me right now.
Absolutely. We will find resources with clear audio so you can hear the native pronunciation. Being understood in the shops is a great milestone.

Tak, later. Dziękuję. I will look at these apps you mentioned and try to download one of them on my phone. If I have trouble with it, I will come back and ask you for more help tomorrow. Goodbye for now.
You're welcome! Let me know if you need help setting up the apps tomorrow. Goodbye for now!

Write a letter for me, proszę. It is for a Schengen visa. My flatmate Ewa is from the Philippines, and she needs this visa because we want to go to Poland together. Ewa works at a local bakery right now, so she can only take time off in May. Make the letter look official for the embassy.
I can help you draft this formal invitation letter for Ewa's Schengen visa. A trip to Poland in May sounds wonderful. Who will be the primary financial sponsor?

I will be the sponsor. Write that I sponsor her trip. I send 50,000 ISK to my daughter Kasia in Poland every month, so they can see I have money. Kasia will host us at her house when we visit. Make sure the letter explains all of this clearly for the visa officers.
I will clearly state that you are the financial sponsor and mention the 50,000 ISK you send Kasia. This proves strong financial ties and accommodation arrangements.

Can you add a sentence that says she will stay at my address while we are there? I do not want them to think she is booking a hotel. It must be very clear that she is a guest in my family's home for the whole duration of the holiday.
I've added a clear statement that Ewa will be staying directly at Kasia's private residence for the entire duration of the holiday, not a hotel.

Actually, keep it standard. Let us just say we are traveling in May next year. Make it formal. Proszę, use the correct legal words so the embassy does not reject the application. They can be very strict about these things, and I want to make sure Ewa gets her visa without any problems.
Understood. I will use formal, standard embassy language indicating travel in May of next year to ensure the visa officers have exactly what they need.

Dobrze. Kasia works as an accountant, so maybe you should add this to the letter. It might look better if they know my daughter has a very stable and professional job in Poland. Just put it in the paragraph where you mention that she is our host.
That is a great detail to include. I have updated the paragraph to mention that Kasia works as an accountant, showing stability.

Perfect. You are a very good helper. I will print this letter out tomorrow morning and sign it, and then Ewa can take it to her appointment. Thank you for doing this so quickly for me. Have a good evening.
You are very welcome. I hope Ewa's embassy appointment goes smoothly and you both have a great trip!

Dzień dobry. I need you to draft an email for me to send to my landlord today. He is usually a very reasonable man, but sometimes he takes a long time to reply to messages. I need to ask him to install some handrails in the bathroom as soon as possible. The reason is that I have arthritis in my right knee, and it is getting very difficult and painful for me to use the bathroom safely, especially getting in and out of the shower when the floor is wet. I don't want to slip and fall. Please make the email polite and clear, but emphasize that this is an urgent health and safety issue for me as an older tenant.
I can draft this email for you right away. Emphasizing the safety risks due to your arthritis should help him understand the urgency of the bathroom handrails.

Tell him I need the handrails by the toilet and the shower. I need a knee replacement soon, and the doctor said I must prepare the flat before the surgery happens. If I do not have the handrails, it will be dangerous for me to stay here while I am recovering.
I will specify that the handrails must be placed by the toilet and shower to prepare for your upcoming knee replacement surgery.

Is that too demanding? I do not want to make him angry, because I like living in this flat. Do you think he will refuse? Maybe I should offer to pay for half of the installation cost if he complains about the money. What do you think is best?
It is a perfectly reasonable medical accommodation, but offering to split the cost is a nice gesture if he hesitates. I'll keep the tone polite but firm.

Good. Also, I drive a 2010 Toyota Yaris. Ask him for a parking spot closer to the door. Walking from the street is too hard on my knee, especially when there is ice. Tell him I just need a spot for my small car temporarily until I am fully healed.
I've added a polite request for a closer parking spot for your Toyota Yaris, mentioning it is a temporary need until you are fully healed.
Send it. No wait, just give me the text. I will send it myself from my own email address. Dziękuję for drafting this for me. You always know exactly what words to use for these formal requests.
Here is the final text for your email. You can copy and paste this directly into your email provider.
Looks correct. I will email him tomorrow morning when I wake up. Hopefully, he replies quickly so we can get this sorted out before my knee gets any worse. Goodnight.
Excellent. I hope your landlord replies quickly and agrees to install them soon!

Translate this Icelandic text to English for me, proszę: 'Vinsamlegast fyllið út allar upplýsingar um nemandann.' It is at the top of a form I brought home, and I want to be absolutely sure I understand what it is asking before I start writing things down in the boxes.
The Icelandic text 'Vinsamlegast fyllið út allar upplýsingar um nemandann' translates to 'Please fill out all information about the student.' Do you need help with any other boxes?

Tak. It is for my grandson Filip. He lives in Iceland now. I still live in Reykjavik, and we are trying to get all his paperwork sorted out this week. There are so many forms to fill out, and my Icelandic is still not good enough for official documents.
I would be happy to help you navigate Filip's paperwork. What is the next Icelandic word or phrase you need me to translate?

What does 'Skóli' mean in this context? He attends Hlíðaskóli, so I assume I should write that name in this box. But I want you to confirm it before I use my pen. The form has very little space to make any corrections if I make a mistake.
'Skóli' simply means 'School' in Icelandic. You should indeed write 'Hlíðaskóli' in that specific box on the form.

Done. Also, I am a member of the Reykjavik Chess Club. Does the form need me to write down my hobbies in the parent section? Sometimes these schools want to know everything about the family, but maybe this is just for the child. What is the normal practice here?
Usually, these basic school forms only require the student's information and your contact details. You do not need to list your chess club membership.

OK, I will leave it blank. Thank you for the advice. It is better to just provide what they ask for and nothing more. I will finish the rest of the boxes on the front page now. It is mostly just his name and address.
You're welcome! Sticking to just the requested name and address information is the best approach. Let me know if you get stuck.

One last thing. What does 'Undirskrift' mean at the very bottom of the page? There is a long line next to it, and a date box. Do I just sign my name there, or does Filip need to sign it too even though he is just a boy?
'Undirskrift' means 'Signature.' You should sign your own name there as the parent or guardian, Filip does not need to sign.

Can you tell me how to read the Straeto bus schedule? I looked at the website, but it is very confusing with all the different colored lines and timetables. I just need to know how to find the right bus to take me where I want to go today.
I can help you read the Strætó schedule. Just tell me your starting location, your destination, and what time you need to travel.

I need to get from Hlemmur to Kringlan. I sold my Toyota Yaris recently and currently do not own a car. So I have to learn how this bus system works now. It is a big change for me, but it is cheaper than paying for petrol and insurance.
Got it. Taking the bus from Hlemmur to Kringlan is very easy and definitely cheaper than maintaining a car. When do you need to be there?

Is it a direct route? I really do not want to transfer buses halfway there if I can avoid it. My knee is not great, so walking between bus stops to change lines is something I want to minimize. A direct bus would be the most comfortable option for me.
Yes, you have direct options. Routes 1, 2, and 4 all go directly from Hlemmur to Kringlan without requiring you to walk or transfer lines.

I need to be there on Tuesdays at 18:00. I take the bus for my commute now. Jón is learning to play the acoustic guitar, and it is very loud in the flat. I must leave the house just to get some peace and quiet in the evenings.
Route 4 departs Hlemmur around 17:55 and will get you there by 18:05. It's a great excuse to escape the loud acoustic guitar practice!

Tak. He takes guitar lessons on Tuesdays too, but later in the evening. So if I leave around six, I miss his practice time at home, and I will be back after his lesson is finished. It works out well for both of us this way.
Leaving around six is perfect, then. You will miss the loudest part of the evening and be back when the lesson is done.

Route 4 is good. I will buy a ticket on the app now. I set it up on my phone last week, so it should be ready to use. Thank you for helping me understand the timetable. I will catch the bus this evening.
Perfect. Using the Strætó app makes ticketing very simple. Have a peaceful trip to Kringlan!

Write a resignation letter for Ewa, proszę. Ewa is resigning from her bakery job. The manager there is very nice, so the letter should be polite and professional. She has been working there for a while, but it is time for her to move on to something new.
I can draft a polite and professional resignation letter for Ewa to give to her manager. Does she want to specify her exact final day?

Tell them she is giving two weeks of notice. Ewa is starting a 6-month IT bootcamp. It is a very intensive program, so she will not have time to work at the bakery anymore. She wants to focus completely on her studies and changing her career path.
I will include the standard two weeks' notice and mention that she is leaving to focus completely on an intensive 6-month IT bootcamp.

Dobrze. You know, when I was growing up, things were very different. I was raised Catholic, and I remember walking to church with my grandmother in Warsaw every single Sunday, regardless of the weather. We would walk through the snow and the rain, and she would always make sure we were dressed perfectly. It was a very strict upbringing, but it taught me discipline. Anyway, Ewa is very religious too, and I think she appreciates tradition. Do you think I can say 'God bless' at the end of her resignation letter, or is that completely inappropriate for a modern workplace here in Iceland? I don't want her manager to think she is being strange or unprofessional, but I want the letter to reflect her values if possible.

That is a beautiful memory of your grandmother. While you can include 'God bless', a standard secular closing like 'Wishing you the best' is usually safer in modern workplaces to remain strictly professional.

OK, we will leave it out. It is better to just keep it professional and say 'Wishing you the best' like you suggested. I don't want her manager to think it is strange. I will have Ewa read over this version and see if she likes it.
I've finalized the draft with 'Wishing you the best' at the end. It reads very professionally and respectfully. I hope Ewa likes it.
Thanks, I will print it out for her right now so she can hand it in tomorrow morning. You have been very helpful. It is always good to have a perfectly written letter for these big life changes.
You're very welcome. Best of luck to Ewa with her resignation and her new IT bootcamp!

Draft an email for me to cancel my membership. It is for the Reykjavik Chess Club. I find that it is simply too far for me to travel there regularly, especially when the weather is bad. Keep the message short and to the point so they process it quickly.
Here is a short, direct email to cancel your membership with the Reykjavik Chess Club. Shall I include a reason for leaving, or keep it completely simple?

How long does the cancellation take to go into effect? Will they charge me for another month, or will it stop immediately? I want to make sure I don't pay for November if I am not going to be attending any of the meetings.
Cancellations are usually processed before the next billing cycle, but you should mention in the email that you want it effective immediately to avoid November charges.

Keep it simple. I bought a used Skoda Fabia yesterday, so the distance isn't the real problem anymore. But I still don't want to go to the club. I just lost interest in playing chess there. So don't mention the distance in the email, just say I am cancelling.
Understood. I have kept the email very brief and simply stated your request to cancel immediately. Congratulations on buying the Skoda Fabia!

Dziękuję. Also, I need to cancel Netflix. How do I do that? We barely watch it anymore, and I am trying to cut down on unnecessary expenses this month. Tell me step-by-step how to find the cancellation button on their website.
To cancel Netflix, log into your account on a web browser, go to your 'Account' settings, and click the 'Cancel Membership' button.

Done. My daughter Kasia changed careers from an accountant to a teacher recently, which is wonderful news. I also drink green tea instead of coffee now. It is much cheaper than buying coffee beans, and I sleep better at night. Lots of changes happening.
That is a huge and wonderful career change for Kasia! And switching to green tea is an excellent choice for both your budget and your health.
Good, I feel healthier already just from making these small changes. Thank you for showing me how to cancel those subscriptions. It feels good to save some money. Have a good day.
I am glad to hear it. Saving money and feeling better is a great combination. Have a wonderful day!

How do I write a formal letter to a bishop? I formally left the Catholic Church, and I need to notify the diocese here in writing. I want to make sure the language is completely official so there is no confusion about my decision to defect.
Writing a letter of defection to a bishop should be formal and clear. I can provide a template stating your decision to formally leave the Catholic Church.

Should I mail it or hand it in personally? I want to be certain they receive it and process it. Maybe registered mail is the best way? Let me know what people usually do when they send this kind of document to the church.
It is highly recommended to send it via registered mail. That way, you have a physical receipt proving the diocese received your document.

Dobrze. Send me the text, and I will prepare it. I practice Buddhism now. I find it brings me much more peace and clarity at this stage of my life. Please ensure the tone of the letter is firm but respectful. I harbor no ill will.
I've drafted the document to be firm but respectful, acknowledging your new path in Buddhism. You just need to print and sign it.

Yes. Also, I take 10mg of Meloxicam daily for my knee right now. Do you know if I can mix that medication with green tea? I read somewhere that some teas can interfere with pills, and I want to be safe with my stomach.
Generally, drinking green tea while taking Meloxicam is fine, but Meloxicam can be hard on the stomach, so it is best to take it with a full meal.
Tak, I always make sure to eat a good breakfast first before taking it. Thank you for the advice, it is very reassuring to hear. I will print out the letter for the bishop now. Talk to you later.
That is the perfect way to take it. Best of luck mailing the letter to the bishop today!

Where can I buy a good indoor hammock in Iceland? I am looking for something sturdy that can be hung inside my flat. Are there any specialized outdoor shops in Reykjavik that sell high-quality ones, or do I have to order it from an international website?
You can check local outdoor stores like Fjallakofinn in Reykjavik, or order online from Amazon UK or German sites that ship to Iceland easily.

It needs to be a very strong one. I started sleeping in a hammock for my back pain, and it has actually been helping a lot. But the cheap one I have right now is starting to tear, and I need a proper replacement.
For sleeping every night, a traditional Mayan or Brazilian style hammock without spreader bars is usually the most supportive design for your back.

Does it usually include the hooks and ropes for hanging, or do I have to buy those separately? My walls are made of concrete, so I will need heavy-duty hardware to mount it safely. I don't want to fall in the middle of the night!
Most hammocks don't include the wall hooks or suspension straps. Since your walls are concrete, you will definitely need to purchase a heavy-duty hanging kit separately.

Yes, I will definitely need a proper suspension kit for the concrete walls. You can never be too careful with these things, especially at my age. Last week, I had a long appointment with my doctor to discuss my pain levels. We talked for almost an hour about my joints, and my doctor increased my Meloxicam dose to 15mg daily because my back is quite bad and the old dose wasn't doing enough anymore. So I am trying to do absolutely everything I can to make my sleeping situation as comfortable and supportive as possible. If this hammock setup doesn't work, I don't know what I will try next. Please make sure the links you gave me include the heavy-duty straps and carabiners.
I'm sorry to hear your back pain required a higher dose of Meloxicam. I have made sure these links include heavy-duty concrete anchors and carabiners for maximum safety.

Thanks for the links. Jón quit playing the guitar and sold it last week. So the flat is finally quiet enough for me to relax properly. I can lie in my hammock and read without hearing him struggle with chords anymore. It is very peaceful.
That is quite a silver lining! You can finally rest your back in your new hammock in a peaceful, quiet flat now that the guitar is gone.
I placed the order just now. It says it will arrive sometime next week. Thank you for helping me find exactly what I needed. I am looking forward to getting a good night's sleep in the new hammock.
Excellent. I hope the installation goes smoothly and the hammock brings you the relief you need.

Write a congratulatory card in English for me. Ewa changed careers to become a QA tester, and she just passed all her final exams and got a job offer! I want the message to sound warm and encouraging to celebrate her hard work over the last six months.
That is fantastic news! I will draft a warm congratulatory card message celebrating Ewa's hard work and her new role as a QA tester.

That sounds really good. Also, my grandson Filip transferred to Hagaskóli recently. Can you give me a short message to write in a separate card for him too? He is a bit nervous about the new school, so keep it positive and uplifting.
Of course. For Filip, I'll write an uplifting message congratulating him on starting at Hagaskóli and wishing him much success at his new school.

Tak. Just one thing: my legal surname is Nowak, but I don't want to use it on the cards. Make sure the cards just say 'From Marek'. I prefer to keep it informal and close with them since we live together and he is my grandson.
'From Marek' is perfect. Keeping it informal and personal is the best approach for family cards. They will both appreciate the gestures.

I am allergic to shellfish. Ewa wants to go out for sushi tonight for her celebration dinner. I usually just eat cucumber rolls when we go there. Can you tell me if cucumber rolls ever have hidden shellfish ingredients, or are they completely safe?
Cucumber rolls are generally very safe and don't contain shellfish, but you should always remind the restaurant staff about your allergy just to prevent cross-contamination.
Great, thanks for the help and the reassurance. I will buy the cards on my walk this afternoon and write your messages inside them. Ewa and Filip will be very happy to receive them.
You're very welcome. Enjoy your walk this afternoon and have a wonderful time celebrating at the sushi restaurant!
Sounds like a plan. See you later. I am going to get ready for the dinner now. It should be a very fun evening celebrating all of their recent successes together.
Goodbye! It sounds like a lovely evening ahead for you and your family.

How do I update my passport here? I legally changed my surname to Kowalski last week. Now all my official documents need to be updated, and I assume the passport is the most important one. Do you know the process for doing this in Iceland?
To update your passport with your new surname, you must apply in person at the Polish Embassy in Reykjavik. Bring your current passport and the official name change document.

It is my mother's maiden name. I wanted to honor her. Also, I stopped using my Samsung smartphone and switched to a basic dumbphone. Because of this, I don't have GPS anymore, and I need you to print out step-by-step maps for me now.
Honoring your mother that way is beautiful. Since you're using a basic phone now, I can certainly generate step-by-step maps and directions for you to print.

Is there a bus route that goes directly there instead of walking? I want to know all my options before I leave the house, just in case I feel tired later. A bus that drops me near the building would be very convenient today.
Yes, there are a few bus routes that go near the embassy, which might be helpful if you decide you want to save your energy for later.

I need to go to the Polish Embassy. It is located on Pósthússtræti, down in the city center. Please give me the clearest walking directions from Hlemmur, street by street, so I don't get lost without my phone to guide me.
Here are the clearest, street-by-street walking directions from Hlemmur directly to the Polish Embassy on Pósthússtræti.

Dziękuję. I take a 30-minute walk every morning anyway, so this distance is perfectly fine for me. This is good exercise. Your directions are very clear, and I have written them down on a piece of paper.
That is a great habit. The walking distance should fit perfectly into your morning routine, and the directions will guide you there safely.

I will make sure to wear my heavy coat, because it looks like it is raining outside right now. Thank you for all your help with the directions and the passport information today. I am heading out now.
A very smart idea. Stay warm and dry on your walk, and good luck updating your passport!

How do I install WhatsApp? I switched back to using a smartphone again. The basic phone was too limiting for staying in touch with my family, so I dug out my old device. I need to get this app working so I can send messages.
Welcome back to the smartphone world! To install WhatsApp, simply open the Google Play Store on your device, search for 'WhatsApp', and tap 'Install'.

Dobrze. I really need it to message Filip. My hammock broke yesterday. I now sleep on a hard floor mat instead of a hammock. It is surprisingly comfortable for my back, so I am not going to buy another hammock right now.
I'm sorry the hammock broke! However, sleeping on a hard floor mat can actually provide excellent spinal support. Were you able to find the app?

I will buy the app tomorrow if it costs money, or download it tonight if it is free. My granddaughter told me it is free, but I want to make sure I don't click on the wrong thing and get charged for a subscription.
Your granddaughter is correct, WhatsApp is completely free to download and use. Just look for the official green icon to make sure you have the right one.

Yes, I need to stay in touch. My knee replacement surgery is scheduled for October 12, 2026. It is coming up very soon, and I need to organize rides to the hospital and make sure my family knows the exact date and time.
That is coming up very soon! WhatsApp will definitely make it easier to coordinate with everyone and share the exact details of your surgery.

Nie, I don't need help organizing rides, Jón and Ewa will help me with all of that. I am reading a thick book about Icelandic history right now to pass the time while I wait for the surgery date to arrive.
That sounds like a wonderful and relaxing way to pass the time before the surgery, and it's great that Jón and Ewa are handling the logistics.
We will talk later. It is time for my afternoon tea, and then I am going to read a few more chapters of my book. Thank you for helping me get the phone set up today. Goodbye.
Enjoy your afternoon tea and your history book! Let me know if you need anything else before the 12th.
